title: LIVE AIR TEMPERATURE
source_name: NOAA/NCEP HRRR 3 km 2 m temperature analysis, hourly cycles
variable: TMP 2 m above ground, analysis step
what: Near-surface (2 m) air temperature from the operational HRRR analysis. Apple-style spectrum: deep blue cold through red warm, with rare extreme cold continuing into blue-violet/violet/deep-purple (continuous through freezing, no break).
why_extreme: Record cold anchors deep purple; record heat anchors the red end; ordinary temperatures own most of the color resolution.
